name: SN-22
summary: SN-22, also known as 3-(1-methyl-4-piperidinyl)indole, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the piperidinylindole group related to the psychedelic drug dimethyltryptamine (DMT). Though it is not technically a tryptamine itself, SN-22 can be regarded as a constrained analogue of DMT.

pharmacology.text: SN-22, also known as 3-(1-methyl-4-piperidinyl)indole, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the piperidinylindole group related to the psychedelic drug dimethyltryptamine (DMT). The drug shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A receptors (Ki = 146–514 nM and 19–67 nM, respectively). A deuterated isotopologue of SN-22 is known to be a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist, albeit with lower potency than DMT.

summaryZh: SN-22是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C14H18N2，化學名3-(1-甲基-4-哌啶基)吲哚，屬於一種哌啶基吲哚類化合物，能與一些5-羥色胺受體發生作用。
summaryZhHans: SN-22是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C14H18N2，化学名3-(1-甲基-4-哌啶基)吲哚，属于一种哌啶基吲哚类化合物，能与一些5-羟色胺受体发生作用。

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study serotonin receptors. It is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究血清素受體的研究用化合物，不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究血清素受体的研究用化合物，不是药物。

fact.en: Its ring system locks DMT's flexible side chain into one fixed shape. Chemists make such constrained analogues to learn which shape a receptor prefers.
fact.zh: 它的環狀結構把DMT原本可自由轉動的側鏈固定成單一形狀。化學家製作這類受限類似物，是為了了解受體偏好哪一種形狀。
fact.zhHans: 它的环状结构把DMT原本可自由转动的侧链固定成单一形状。化学家制作这类受限类似物，是为了了解受体偏好哪一种形状。
